title: Mechanized Deterministic Pipeline: Steps 3->7->8(retry<=2)->9 (V2.11)
description: Reference shapes for scripts/analyze_pipeline.py's run_analyze_pipeline() (docs/decisiones.md D-066, capability A-03). This script NEVER performs SKILL.md Step 6 (Analysis) - draft_report must already be the AI-authored draft for the same source being preprocessed. It reuses preprocess.run()/score.score_report()/validate_report.validate_report()/render_report.render_markdown()/render_html() UNCHANGED.

needsRevisionResult.description: Returned when validate_report() still finds errors and the SKILL.md Step 8 retry cap (at most 2 retries, 3 attempts total) has not yet been reached.

errors.description: The UNMODIFIED error list from validate_report.validate_report().

preprocessArtifact.description: The UNMODIFIED Step 3 output of preprocess.run().

renderedResult.description: Returned when validate_report() finds zero errors - Step 9 (render) has run.

preprocessArtifact.description: The UNMODIFIED Step 3 output of preprocess.run().

businessRules: R-A1: This module never performs Step 6 (Analysis). draft_report is always an external, already AI-authored input - there is no code path that inspects a finding's substance or invents/edits one.

R-A2: attempt is a caller-declared, never-inferred integer in [1,3] (SKILL.md Step 8: at most 2 retries, 3 attempts total). Any other value (including a non-int, a bool, or a value outside the range) raises AnalyzePipelineError BEFORE Step 3 (preprocess) even runs.

R-A3: A still-invalid report on attempt 1 or 2 returns status='needs_revision' (never raises) - the caller may still fix the draft and retry. A still-invalid report on attempt 3 (the last allowed attempt) raises AnalyzePipelineError - never returned as if it were a normal result, matching SKILL.md's 'never present an unvalidated report as if it were normal.'

R-A4: Step 7 (score) and Step 8 (validate) and Step 9 (render) are exactly score.score_report()/validate_report.validate_report()/render_report.render_markdown() or render_html() UNCHANGED - this module owns zero scoring/validation/rendering logic of its own, including the HTML allowHtmlReport mode gate, which lives inside render_html() itself and is never bypassed or re-implemented here.

R-A5: This module makes no network/API calls, holds no credentials, and stores nothing between calls - attempt counting is entirely the caller's responsibility, exactly like monitor_diff.py's snapshotTimestamp and pr_gate.py's refLabel are caller-declared, never inferred.
